item.title: Ritchie — Distributed Application Programming Language
item.description: Build stateful distributed applications as one program. Ritchie makes services, durable entities, streams and recoverable failures first-class language concepts.

item.title: Ritchie Playground Is Live — Ritchie News
item.description: The Ritchie Playground is live, with an early look at the language architecture, syntax and implicit error handling.

item.title: Try Ritchie — Browser playground
item.description: Write and run a single-file Ritchie program in the browser playground.

item.title: Distributed Hello World — Ritchie preview
item.description: Build a distributed Hello World application and see how Ritchie makes persistence, concurrency and network boundaries part of the program.

item.title: RITE — Ritchie runtime model
item.description: RITE — Reliable Interaction with Typed Endpoints — is the runtime model underneath Ritchie's programming model.

item.title: Ritchie Skill — Teach Your Coding Agent Ritchie
item.description: Download the Ritchie Agent Skill and install it in your coding harness to write, run, explain and learn Ritchie.
